result:
Signed-in users can now comment on posts, delete comments when allowed, and report them; a comment reported by three different users no longer appears on the post page. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass: 8 tests, including 6 new ones that cover every check in the ticket. I didn't start the app or try the page in a browser.

**Storage.** New `comments` and `comment_reports` tables in `db/schema.ts`, with the migration `db/migrations/20260929144143_add_comments`. The pair (`comment_id`, `user_id`) is unique, so a repeated report by the same user still counts once. SQLite only enforces "delete the comments with the post" when foreign keys are switched on, so `PostController.destroy` also deletes a post's comments and their reports itself.

**Endpoints** (`routes/web.ts`, all behind the existing `auth` redirect to `/login`):
- `POST /posts/:id/comments` checks the body the same way post titles are checked today: it's trimmed, must be 1–2000 characters, and nothing is stored if it fails. On success it redirects to the post.
- `DELETE /comments/:id` works for the comment's author or the post's author and redirects to the post. Anyone else gets 403 and the comment stays. The permission rule is in `app/Policies/CommentPolicy.ts`.
- `POST /comments/:id/report` returns 204 every time.

**Post page.** `GET /posts/:id` now also passes `comments` (oldest first, hidden ones removed) alongside the unchanged `post`. `posts/Show.tsx` lists them with author and time, shows a comment box when signed in, and shows Delete and Report where the viewer can use them.

Two behaviours you might not assume:
- A body that is only spaces is rejected, because it's trimmed first, as titles are.
- Deleting a comment also removes its reports, so there's nothing left for the later review screen to read. Hidden comments themselves stay in `comments` as the ticket asks.

In summary, the new files are `app/Models/Comment.ts`, `app/Models/CommentReport.ts`, `app/Policies/CommentPolicy.ts`, `app/Http/Controllers/CommentController.ts`, `app/Http/Resources/CommentResource.ts`, `app/Http/Validators/CommentValidator.ts`, the migration, and `tests/CommentController.test.ts`. I changed `db/schema.ts`, `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts` (show lists comments and leaves out ones with three or more reports; destroy removes comments and their reports), `app/Providers/AuthorizationProvider.ts` (registers the comment policy), `routes/web.ts` and `resources/js/pages/posts/Show.tsx`. The `.guren/*.gen.ts` files were regenerated with `bun run codegen`.
